new_scholarship.description: The UCAS Scholarship for International Students is a University of Chinese Academy of Sciences award for non-Chinese-citizen students pursuing a Master's or doctoral degree, or attending courses, conducting research or making academic visits at UCAS colleges and CAS institutes. It has two tiers: a full scholarship covering tuition waiver, application fee waiver, monthly stipend, basic accommodation and medical insurance, and a partial scholarship covering only the tuition waiver, insurance and application fee. Awards run for no longer than 36 months, and the full tier publishes RMB 40,000/year (PhD) or RMB 30,000/year (Master's) tuition waived plus a monthly stipend of RMB 2,500 (PhD) or RMB 2,000 (Master's), with a combined total of at least RMB 3,500 or RMB 3,000 once the host assistantship is added.
